_comment: Measured baseline for scripts/lab/hideout_footprint.py (#935), from On-call's lab runs on main b6ce0081 (11/10, after #967): the max of the window-shown and window-hidden runs. A metric fails past value * (1 + pct/100) + slack, or past max where an entry has one. loop_wakes_per_s is the gate's wake limit (#1000): the hub's own event-loop wakes, at most 1/s hidden to the tray with no flyout (value: ~8 per 10 min plus the lab's report wake every 15 s); loop_wakes_shown_per_s is the shown window's own limit, provisional until On-call's first --state shown run. wakeups_per_s (context switches, mostly the NVIDIA OpenGL driver thread and other OS work) is recorded as INFO only and never fails; its value is kept for reference (see docs/hideout-footprint.md). Private memory ~75 MB is the glow/egui/GPU stack floor on this machine. The default set is empty for now, so it shares the numbers.
